criticalDistinctions.rule: 352.67 ft NAVD88 is the published gage-zero datum conversion for USGS 03378500; 352.71 ft NAVD88 is the separate monitoring-location/site altitude. Distinct quantities — never conflate. Covered by backend tests (backend/app/main.py: USGS_POSEY_GAGE_DATUM_NAVD88_FT / USGS_POSEY_GAGE_SITE_ALTITUDE_NAVD88_FT).
Streamflow/discharge (ft³/s) and water-surface elevation (ft NAVD88) are distinct quantities. Never synthesize NAVD88 WSE from discharge without a validated rating/model.
USACE eHydro channel surveys (Ohio River miles 776–976) are in Ohio River Datum, NOT NAVD88. Datum offsets are not in-hand.

projectStandards.horizontalCrsDisplay: EPSG:3857 — WGS 84 / Pseudo-Mercator. Display CRS for MapLibre GL JS and Terrain-RGB tiles.
projectStandards.horizontalCrsEngineering: EPSG:2966 — NAD83 / Indiana State Plane West (ftUS). Native CRS for engineering computations.
projectStandards.horizontalCrsExchange: EPSG:4326 — WGS 84 (degrees). Exchange CRS for published GeoJSON (e.g. tsm-console/public/data/posey-parcels.geojson).
projectStandards.verticalDatum: NAVD88 — North American Vertical Datum of 1988. All project elevations in feet.
projectStandards.verticalDatumNote: USGS 3DEP DEMs and Indiana statewide DEM report NAVD88 natively. Ohio River channel surveys use Ohio River Datum (NOT NAVD88) — offsets not in-hand; never conflate.
